summary: The PR addresses a missing cache clearing step in the `_unregister_lookup` method, ensuring consistency with the `register_lookup` method. However, it introduces a new test case that may be overly specific to the failing scenario.

issues.description: The addition of a new test case (`schema.tests.SchemaTests.test_func_unique_constraint_lookups`) appears to be an overfitting solution. It should be reviewed to ensure it covers a broader range of scenarios.
